name: Terminated employees remain on payroll -> ghost employee risk
rationale: A lag between termination and removal from the payroll master, combined with bulk electronic payments, creates the opportunity for continued payments to non-employees. The rule directs occurrence-focused testing: analytical scans, tracing leavers, and vouching payees to employment evidence.
source_reference: Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
